title: Flight-Sim Hours Toward a Goal
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightsim:session
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(duration_min) as minutes by _time
| eval hours=round(minutes/60,1)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks your weekly flight-sim hours toward a training or currency-practice goal.
value: Regular sim practice builds procedural skill cheaply; a weekly total keeps the habit going between real flights.
implementation: Ingest sim sessions into `index=personal`; total hours per week.
visualization: Column chart of weekly flight-sim hours.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how many hours you spend in the flight simulator each week toward your goal.
